notes.title: Newest update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow adventurers! Here's a new patch that fixes some bugs, as well as other fixes and improvements aimed at making the game smoother and more user-friendly.

- A glitch in the Sexy Foxes military camp has been fixed

- The values of many potions and items have been adjusted for balance

- Improved gameplay and combat system balancing

- The names and values of the Fireball, Antifreeze, and Rage skills have been changed

- Enhancement of dialogues by including content that hints at secrets

- Other minor bugs and issues have been addressed

Please let us know if there are any bugs left, and we'll do our best to fix them right away.

Also, don't forget to check out the other adventures in the Shaola series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124210/Heroes_of_Shaola/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die/

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

While we strive to finish testing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die]Mysteries of Shaola: The Princess Must Die[/url], our The Cave team just complete another update.

Since the majority of the bugs have already been fixed, this update only contains enhancements rather than the lengthy list of changes found in the previous one.

[list]
[*] The graphics of some of the characters have been improved, removing some dark areas

[*] Some animation graphics have been improved to give it a slightly better appearance

[*] To enhance the AI, some variables have been added to the boss battles

[*] To improve the game's balance, some items' prices and effectiveness have been changed

[*] Some unnecessary and illogical character skills have been removed; having too many skills isn't always a good thing

[*] A loophole was discovered in one of the Denzel/Helen's premium skills and have been fixed
[/list]

As always, we're welcoming any feedback.

And if you haven't already, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die]add Mysteries of Shaola: The Princess Must Die to your wishlist[/url].

Thank you for your interest in the Shaola series; we hope you enjoy it as much as we do. ːsteamthumbsupː

- Shaola team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die/

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers! Here is a new patch that squashes pretty much all bugs as well as other fixes and enhancement that intent to be more user-friendly to casual players and non-traditional RPG enthusiasts.

[list]
[*] Minor balancing to the gameplay and battles
[*] Further enhancement to the scenes and dialogues
[*] Minor revising to the relationship and interaction between main characters   
[*] A few story scenes and plots have been carefully enhanced to bring each character to life
[*] 2 minor graphic issues have been fixed
[*] 2 minor movement and passability errors have been fixed
[*] 5 confusing instructions and dialogues in the Southern Plains have been removed or replaced for better clarity on where to go next 
[*] Minor modification to the enemies, spoils, level rewards and game difficulty
[*] A few cutscenes have been modified
[*] Minor tweaks to the monsters, spoils and game balance
[*] Energizer's value and effectiveness have been reduced for balance purpose
[*] Minor changes and improvement to the main characters and NPCs’ dialogues
[*] Some melodies and sound effects have been added and/or improved, especially on important scenes or characters’ reactions
[*] Minor enhancement to the characters’ graphics
[*] A few stats have been tweaked to balance out the game
[*] All major bugs and glitches have been fixed
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update. If there are any bugs left, please don’t hesitate to let us know, we'll try to fix them ASAP. You can always contact us on here in Steam community or our support team’s email address at [b]support@shaolarpg.com[/b], we’ll get back to you ASAP.

Steam community is the most important to us, we’re working hard on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die/]Mysteries of Shaola: The Princess Must Die[/url] but still trying our best to pay close attention on previous titles.

And please don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die/]Wishlist Mysteries of Shaola: The Princess Must Die[/url] if you haven’t already.

Thanks for your support and we hope you'll enjoy the Shaola series as much as we do. ːsteamhappyː

Shaola Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2145290/Mysteries_of_Shaola_The_Princess_Must_Die/
